description: Diff a saved graph snapshot against the current live graph. Useful for change reviews and post-incidents — answers "what changed in the architecture between then and now." Returns added/removed/changed nodes and edges with both snapshot timestamps.

againstSnapshot.description: Path or http(s) URL of the snapshot to diff against (the "before" state). The current graph is the "after".

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_graph_diff
